note: Official trophy names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them (via the Exophase and PSNProfiles listings, which agree on every name, description and grade). Hidden flags follow the same published listing: 28 trophies stay hidden until earned. Guides are written for this entry in its own words, with the source of each fact named beside it. The game was not yet released when this guide was written; where the exact unlock method is still unconfirmed, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no shortcut and no separate task of its own. Follow the roadmap in order, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and leave cheats off for the whole run, since cheats disable trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Work the roadmap stages in order, from the story first through to cleanup.
Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
Keep cheats off for the entire run, since using them disables trophies and saving.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission Gone Fishing. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed: just play the story. The mission is an early one, so expect this to be among the first trophies you earn. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway, as the same habit protects the one trophy that can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the story until the mission Gone Fishing appears in your objectives.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
If you are chasing the missable meditation trophy, start its spots from this chapter onward.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Chapter 1 is also where the one missable trophy starts: Lucia's balcony meditation spot is offered in this chapter and disappears after it, so meditate there before you finish the chapter. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Before the chapter's final mission, find Lucia's balcony meditation spot and meditate there.
Make a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you need to go back.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Chapter 2 is where both Jason and Lucia become playable, which opens up most of the rest of the list, so expect several other trophies to start unlocking alongside it. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 2.
Play through every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Several heist and partner trophies tie into missions in this stretch of the story, so watch for the partner and robbery objectives as they appear rather than rushing past them. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
Play through every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. By this point the story is near its end, so this is also the moment to check your progress on the chapter-linked collectibles and meditation spots before the finale. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Play through every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: The gold trophy for finishing the story. Complete the final mission and the trophy pops at the end of the credits sequence. Make a manual save before the final mission: it is the natural point of no return, and a save here lets you mop up anything left without replaying the whole story. There is no mission replay, so that save matters.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save before starting the final mission.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops when the story ends.
After the credits, use your chapter saves and free roam to finish the remaining stages.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so just play the story through it. Mission trophies like this one are the backbone of the first roadmap stage: they all pop on their own as the story advances.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until the mission Breakfast Run appears.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 heist mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Treat heist missions as practice for the standalone robbery trophies later: the same mechanics of casing, entry and escape come back in the bank vault and armored truck trophies.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until the mission The Cartel Heist appears (Chapter 3).
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Nothing extra is needed: play the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until the mission Child's Play appears.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Play the story through it and the trophy pops on its own.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until the mission Headliners appears.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. The airport is also the setting for the unscheduled-departure trophy, so learn the layout while you are here: it comes back in the heist and heat stage.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until the mission VCIA Takedown appears.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Play the story through it and the trophy pops on its own.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until the mission Operation Savage Glory appears.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: The gold trophy for 100% completion, and the hardest trophy on the list: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, with this trophy the main reason. Completion is a checklist of its own (story, strangers, collectibles, activities and challenges), so this trophy pops last, after every stage of the roadmap is done. Track it through this guide's checklist rather than guessing: anything unfinished here is unfinished there.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and every strangers strand first; they are the largest share of the checklist.
Clear the collectibles and activities stages, watching the in-game completion percentage.
Finish the last challenges and side tasks, then the trophy pops at 100%.

trophies.guide: Stunts are the game's jump and airtime challenges: ramps, jumps and near-misses counted across free roam and races. 250 is a grind, not a skill wall, so treat it as a background counter while you do everything else: take ramps whenever you see them, use the fastest bikes and cars on open roads, and let the total climb across the whole run instead of farming it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Take every ramp and jump you pass in free roam; each counts toward the 250.
Use fast bikes on open roads and airport runways for long airtime.
Check the counter in the stats menu now and then; it climbs across the whole run.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: play one of everything. The activities are the shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the side content. The fastest way is to work down the activities list in the roadmap's third stage and tick each one off as you try it: one attempt is enough, you do not need to win or finish first.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note every type the game offers.
Try each type once; a single attempt counts, winning is not required.
Tick each off in this guide as you go so nothing is missed.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The Shooting Range grades each challenge on time and accuracy, and gold means hitting every target cleanly and fast. Work one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's target layout before going for gold, and use the range's practice runs to build the muscle memory: the gold thresholds are strict, but the layout never changes, so repetition is the whole method.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Open the Shooting Range and play each challenge once to learn its layout.
Replay each challenge for gold, focusing on accuracy first and speed second.
Gold every challenge; the trophy pops when the last one turns gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at several spots around Leonida, and this trophy needs a win at each one. Drones handle differently from cars: learn the gates and the boost lines on a practice run, then race to win. Work through the locations one by one and tick them off in this guide so you can see which spots are left.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race locations on the map and visit them in turn.
Practice a location once to learn its gates, then race to win it.
Win at every location; the trophy pops with the last win.

trophies.guide: Twenty different races won, across the game's race types: street races, off-road, boat and air races all count toward their own events, and the trophy counts distinct races, not repeat wins of the same one. Enter races from the map, win them, and move on to the next: variety is the requirement, so spread your wins across types and locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races from the map across different types and locations.
Win each race; a repeat win of a race you already won does not count.
Win 20 different races and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fishing challenges pit you against Cal, a rival angler. Win a challenge by landing more or better fish than he does in the time given. Learn the casting and reeling rhythm on a practice cast first: the challenge is a timing game, and a steady reel beats frantic button presses.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge.
Cast, hook and reel steadily; timing beats speed.
Out-fish Cal in the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Play any arcade machine to completion. Arcades are found in bars and amusement spots around Leonida; pick a machine, play a full game through to its end screen, and the trophy pops. One game is enough, so choose the shortest machine you find first.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine in a bar or amusement spot.
Play one full game through to its end screen.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: A contact-strand trophy: finish Andy's mission line, ending with his final mission. Contact strands unlock as you meet people in the story, so if Andy's missions have not appeared yet, keep playing the story and check your phone and map for his calls and markers. The trophy pops when his final mission ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Work through his whole mission line in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: A contact-strand trophy: finish Kenton's mission line, ending with his final mission. Kenton's missions appear as the story opens up his part of Leonida; take them as they come and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Work through his whole mission line in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: A contact-strand trophy: finish Billy's mission line, ending with his final mission. Billy's missions appear as the story opens up; take them as they come and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Meet Billy through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Work through his whole mission line in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers and Freaks strands are the game's wandering side characters: eight full strands, each several missions long, scattered across Leonida. They appear as question-mark markers and phone contacts once the story opens their regions. Work them one strand at a time and tick each off here; the trophy pops when the eighth strand is complete.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Watch for stranger markers and calls as new regions open up.
Complete a full strand, then move on to the next; partial strands do not count.
Finish 8 complete strands and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: A contact-strand trophy: finish Randy's mission line, ending with his final mission. Randy's missions appear as the story opens up his part of Leonida; take them as they come and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Meet Randy through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Work through his whole mission line in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: A contact-strand trophy: finish Tyrone's mission line, ending with his final mission. Tyrone's missions appear as the story opens up; take them as they come and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Work through his whole mission line in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT CAN BE MISSED. Meditation spots are scattered across Leonida, and the first one is offered at Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1: that spot disappears after the chapter ends, and there is no mission replay. Meditate at the balcony spot before finishing Chapter 1, then visit every other spot as you explore, using the map markers. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter so a missed spot can be recovered.
trophies.missableReason: Lucia's balcony meditation spot is offered in Chapter 1 and disappears after that chapter. There is no mission replay, so a missed spot cannot be revisited on the same save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot BEFORE the chapter's final mission.
Make a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.
Visit every meditation spot across Leonida as you explore, checking them off here.
The trophy pops when the last spot is meditated at.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a specific unique animal: a one-of-a-kind creature somewhere in Leonida's wilds. Track it with the hunting tools the game gives you, approach downwind and quietly, and take the shot cleanly. The animal is unique, so there is only one chance per spawn: if it flees, leave the area and return rather than chasing it across the map.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunt and note which animal he wants and where it roams.
Track it quietly and approach from downwind.
Take the shot cleanly and return the kill to Bret.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in sets, and three complete sets are needed. Cards hide in shops, bars, houses and odd corners; check shelves, counters and back rooms as you explore. Track your sets in this guide: the card menu shows which cards of each set you already hold, so work set by set instead of grabbing cards at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick one card set and hunt its cards using the in-game card menu to see what is missing.
Search shops, bars and houses thoroughly; cards hide on shelves and counters.
Complete 3 full sets and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the game's photo-spot activity: find 100 marked locations across Leonida and snap them. The spots are spread over the whole map, so this is a long exploration trophy that pairs naturally with the explore-all-of-Leonida trophy. Use the in-game WAiNK map to see which spots remain, and clear them region by region.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK map to see the photo spots you have not visited.
Clear spots region by region as you explore Leonida.
Photograph the 100th location and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's long list of side goals: stunt counts, driving feats, combat feats, collection milestones and more. Fifty is a lot, so treat this as a background trophy: play normally, check the challenges menu often, and deliberately chase the easy ones (short drives, simple stunts) once the story is done. It pairs with almost every other stage of the roadmap.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Check the challenges menu and note the easiest ones first.
Chase easy challenges (short drives, simple stunts) between other stages.
Complete 50 challenges and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A partner trophy: with your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you for the whole escape, so plan the route before you trigger the heat: pick open roads with few dead ends, keep a fast car ready, and break line of sight before the search circle closes. The trophy pops when the wanted stars clear with your partner still in the car.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along and have a fast car ready on open roads.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then drive to break line of sight.
Escape with your partner still in the car; the trophy pops when the stars clear.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: A partner trophy: rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole way through. The trick is the route: pick three shops close together on quiet streets, hit them fast, and keep moving between them without stopping to fight. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together on quiet streets and plan the route.
Rob the first shop with your partner, then move straight to the next.
Rob all three back-to-back without losing your wanted level.

trophies.guide: A discovery trophy: find 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Every new vehicle you drive counts, from sedans and bikes to boats and aircraft. It climbs naturally as you explore, but you can speed it up by visiting car parks, docks and the airport and hopping into anything new. The vehicle list in the game shows what you have found so far.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive anything new you see; each new vehicle counts once.
Visit car parks, docks and the airport to find rarer vehicles.
Discover the 100th vehicle and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and sharpens your aim; this trophy needs five takedowns inside one use of it. Find a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus with a full meter, and chain the shots: aim for the closest targets first and keep the meter alive by landing hits. Practice the timing in a quiet fight before attempting it in a busy one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with a cluster of enemies and fill your Combat Focus meter.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it ends.
The trophy pops with the fifth takedown in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: An airport trophy: leave Vice City International Airport by an unscheduled route, in the game's own words. The cleanest reading is to take a plane out without going through the terminal: steal or borrow an aircraft on the airfield and take off. The airport layout you learned in the VCIA Takedown story mission helps here: use the runways and service roads, not the departures hall.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Head to VCIA and get onto the airfield, avoiding the terminal.
Take an aircraft and depart from the runway.
The trophy pops on your unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: A tank trophy: get into a Rhino tank and make it count. Rhinos appear at military sites and during high wanted levels; once you are in one, the trophy is about using it: drive it, fire its cannon, and cause the chaos the description hints at. Expect a heavy police response, so do it when you are ready for a fight, not mid-way through another trophy.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank at a military site or during a high wanted level.
Get in and drive it; fire the cannon as the trophy's wording hints.
The trophy pops once you have used the tank as intended.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: hit a jewelry store and get out with nobody spotting you. Plan it like a quiet job: case the store first, go in when it is quiet, move slowly, avoid the cameras and the guard's sightlines, and leave before the alarm can be raised. If you are spotted, leave and try again another day; detection is the only thing that fails it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Case the jewelry store: note the guard, the cameras and the quiet hours.
Enter quietly, take the goods and avoid every sightline.
Leave undetected; the trophy pops when the robbery completes clean.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults are the big robberies: five of them, each needing a plan and a clean escape. The story's Cartel Heist teaches the pattern (casing, entry, escape); apply it five times across different banks. Bring a fast getaway car, know your route out before you go in, and escape cleanly after each one: the trophy counts vaults robbed and escaped from, not just entered.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Case a bank vault and plan the entry and the escape route first.
Rob the vault and escape cleanly; repeat at four more banks.
The trophy pops after the fifth clean vault escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida. Intercept one, stop it, crack it open and escape with the cash. The simplest method is to ram it off the road in a quiet stretch, then deal with the crew quickly and leave before the police response builds. One truck, one clean escape, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and pick a quiet stretch to hit it.
Stop the truck, crack it open and take the cash.
Escape cleanly; the trophy pops when the robbery completes.

trophies.guide: Visit every region of the state: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the inland towns. The map tracks your exploration, so the trophy is about coverage: drive the coast road, cross the bridges, and check the map for grey areas you have not visited yet. It pairs with the WAiNK photo spots and the vehicle discovery trophies, so do them together region by region.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive the whole map: coast road, bridges, swamps and inland towns.
Check the map for grey, unvisited areas and go to them.
The trophy pops when every region is explored.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations: stash houses, labs, chop shops. Rob one operation per gang. Each gang's territory is marked by its presence on the streets, so work gang by gang, learn each operation's layout, and hit them one at a time. The trophy counts gangs covered, so tick each gang off in this guide as you finish its operation.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Learn which gangs hold territory and where their operations sit.
Rob one illegal operation for each gang, one at a time.
The trophy pops when every gang's operation has been hit.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet moment trophy: order a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and enjoy the view. The exact method is still unconfirmed by the guide sites, so the honest advice is to visit the Ocean Beach bars, order a drink, and take in the view; it may pop while you play normally. Check the guide sites again after launch for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Visit the bars along Ocean Beach and order a cocktail.
Take in the view; the trophy's exact trigger is still unconfirmed at the time of writing.
If it does not pop, check the guide sites for the confirmed method after launch.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A showroom-smash trophy: drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car outside, and drive through: the trophy is about the spectacle, so a clean, fast run through the glass is the whole of it. The exact showroom is still unconfirmed by the guide sites, so any large vehicle showroom is the place to try.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a large vehicle showroom and line up a fast car outside.
Drive straight through the showroom glass and out the other side.
The trophy pops on the smash; the exact showroom is still unconfirmed at the time of writing.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A bowling trophy at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: play a game there and follow through, as the description puts it. Visit the alley, bowl a full game, and the trophy should pop on a proper follow-through. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guide sites, so treat it as a visit-and-play trophy and check the sites again after launch if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Bowl a full game with a proper follow-through.
The trophy pops on the game; the exact trigger is still unconfirmed at the time of writing.

trophies.guide: A partner trophy with a cryptic description, and no confirmed unlock method yet: the guide sites list it among the trophies whose exact trigger is still unconfirmed. The likeliest reading is a co-op moment with your partner that the public loves, so play the partner content as it comes and watch for it. Check the guide sites again after launch for the confirmed method rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the partner content as it comes in the story.
Watch for a public, crowd-pleasing partner moment.
The exact trigger is unconfirmed at the time of writing; check the guide sites after launch.

trophies.guide: A choice trophy with a cryptic description, and no confirmed unlock method yet: the guide sites list it among the trophies whose exact trigger is still unconfirmed. The likeliest reading is a story choice with consequences, so keep playing and make your choices deliberately; it may pop while you play normally. Check the guide sites again after launch for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the story and make your choices deliberately when they come up.
The trophy's exact trigger is unconfirmed at the time of writing.
Check the guide sites after launch for the confirmed method.

trophies.guide: A second-chance trophy with a cryptic description, and no confirmed unlock method yet: the guide sites describe it as a hidden second-chance event whose exact method remains unverified. The likeliest reading is failing at something, then succeeding on the second try. If it does not pop in normal play, check the guide sites after launch for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play normally; a second-chance event is the likeliest trigger.
If a retry prompt appears, take it and succeed on the second attempt.
The exact method is unconfirmed at the time of writing; check the guide sites after launch.

trophies.guide: A surprise-event trophy with a cryptic description, and no confirmed unlock method yet: the guide sites list it among the trophies whose exact trigger is still unconfirmed. The likeliest reading is a random world event that catches you off guard, so keep exploring and let the world surprise you. Check the guide sites again after launch for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Keep exploring Leonida and engaging with odd world events.
The trophy's exact trigger is unconfirmed at the time of writing.
Check the guide sites after launch for the confirmed method.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by trophy: knock enemies over with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The cleanest way is to drive slowly past a group, lean out, and swing: the trophy needs the hits to land as a drive-by, not on foot. Pick a quiet street with a few enemies, keep the speed low so the swings connect, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Find a quiet street with a few enemies and a slow vehicle.
Drive past and swing a melee weapon from the moving vehicle.
The trophy pops when the drive-by hits land.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies, and your contacts launder them clean for a cut. Earn $250,000 of clean money this way: rob, collect the marked bills, then hand them to a contact to launder. The total is cumulative across the whole run, so feed the contacts steadily after every robbery instead of saving the bills up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob banks, trucks and stores to collect Marked Bills.
Hand the bills to your contacts to launder them, taking the clean cash.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops: clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything that costs money. The total is cumulative, so it climbs on its own as you gear up for the other stages. If it is the last trophy standing, the fastest way to finish it is car modifications and weapon purchases, which are the biggest single tickets.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes and car mods as you play; every dollar counts.
Watch the cumulative total in the stats menu.
Reach $100,000 spent in total and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garages are bought from the property listings once you have the cash; each one adds storage for your vehicle collection, which pairs with the vehicle discovery and Scooter Bros trophies. Work through the listings and buy them all: the trophy pops with the last purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn or save enough cash for the garage properties.
Buy each garage from the property listings.
The trophy pops with the last garage purchased.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the game's vehicle-delivery app: register vehicles you find to it, ten in total. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so fold this into the vehicle discovery trophy: whenever you find a new ride, register it to Scooter Bros before moving on. Ten registrations and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Drive a vehicle you have not registered yet.
Register it to the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles and the trophy pops.
